observation: Class IIa HDAC to MEF2 to GLUT1 repression shown for HDAC4 (mouse cardiac); HDAC5 binds MEF2A and shuttles in neurons
relation_hypothesised: HDAC5 represses SLC2A1 through MEF2 by a deacetylase-independent scaffold/localization mechanism
possible_action: Reduce HDAC5 protein (not catalysis) to raise GLUT1
context: HDAC4 in mouse heart (failure after infarction; ischaemia-reperfusion, cardiomyocytes); HDAC5 SPR in vitro and cultured hippocampal neurons (species not stated in the abstract); proposed target human neural cells
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (HDAC4 axis; HDAC5 MEF2 binding; HDAC5 shuttling); relation=inferred (HDAC5 to SLC2A1 not shown); action=speculative
favourable_reason: Scaffold function not reached by a catalytic site inhibitor; PROTAC precedent for HDAC7
unfavourable_or_alternative: No HDAC5-SLC2A1 data in neurons; MC1568 did derepress Bdnf; HDAC4 vs HDAC5 differ
discriminating_experiment: Inhibitor vs siRNA/PROTAC vs rescue panel with promoter ChIP and MEF2 reporter
reasoning_pattern: A mechanism shown for one paralog in other tissues is transferred to a second paralog in neurons by way of a shared node (MEF2)

observation: Class IIa catalytic domain has weak activity (His to Tyr); HDAC3 complex carries activity
relation_hypothesised: Catalytic inhibitor of HDAC5 targets only a minor function and so fails to mimic knockdown
possible_action: Selective HDAC5 catalytic inhibitor expected to have little GLUT1 effect
context: Class IIa catalytic domains in vitro; Bdnf promoter in neurons
benefit_to_verify: Rules the inhibitor route in or out
favourable_reason: Class IIa low intrinsic activity; scaffold unaffected by active-site blockers
unfavourable_or_alternative: Bdnf data show a class II inhibitor derepressing; HDAC3 recruitment uncited; pocket occupancy might alter conformation or shuttling (not discussed)
discriminating_experiment: Catalytic-dead HDAC5 rescue in knockdown background plus selective inhibitor arm
reasoning_pattern: Low intrinsic enzymatic activity of a protein is taken to imply that blocking it leaves function unchanged when scaffold roles exist

observation: Wwox-null mice hypoglycemic; neuronal WWOX rescues hypoglycemia and seizures; raising GLUT1 helps Glut1DS mice
relation_hypothesised: A GLUT1 increase in WWOX deficiency is compensatory fuel delivery
possible_action: Raise GLUT1 (via HDAC5 reduction) in WWOX-deficient brain
context: Wwox-null mouse; Glut1DS mouse; proposed human WWOX-deficient neurons
benefit_to_verify: Reduced hypoglycemia and seizures, better energy balance
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (mouse hypoglycemia; Glut1DS augmentation); relation=inferred by analogy; action=speculative
unfavourable_or_alternative: WWOX loss raises GLUT1 via HIF1alpha (Warburg); GLUT1 could already be elevated; brain glucose transport and blood glucose are different compartments
discriminating_experiment: Baseline GLUT1/uptake in WWOX-deficient vs isogenic neurons; OCR/ECAR, ATP/ADP, MEA excitability after GLUT1 rise
reasoning_pattern: A therapeutic direction established in a neighbouring transporter disorder is transferred to the genotype by way of a shared metabolic deficit

discriminating_experiment: Selective HDAC5 degrader vs inhibitor head-to-head
